image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a dark, arched stone tunnel or corridor leading to a bright, barred gate. The walls are rough-hewn stone or brick, curving into an arch overhead. At the end of the tunnel is a tall, rectangular opening filled with a heavy metal grid or bars, topped by an arched window section also barred. Light streams in from outside, creating high contrast.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility interior rather than a generic dungeon or cellar.
To verify the linear perspective of the tunnel converges correctly and the gate sits flush with the opening without geometric melting.
To ensure the individual bars of the gate are distinct, continuous entities and do not merge into the background or each other.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the stone walls or noise patterns indicative of AI generation.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the metal bars (continuity, thickness consistency)
Perspective convergence of the tunnel walls
Texture realism of the stone/brick walls
Lighting consistency between the dark interior and bright exterior
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the metal bars with the stone frame. AI often struggles with clean occlusion boundaries here. Also, verify if the 'grime' or texture on the walls looks naturally accumulated or procedurally noisy/repetitive.
